title: New perspectives on old drugs: Bioactive potentials of pyridazine sulfa drug Schiff bases and copper(II) complexes.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吡哒嗪磺胺席夫碱及铜配合物的抗氧化与DNA结合活性，虽涉及小分子-DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为药物小分子而非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法以常规对接和光谱实验为主，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Integrating various bioactive structural components into a single molecule typically enhances the overall pharmacophoric efficacy. In this study, a new series of pyridazine sulfa drug Schiff bases and their copper(II) complexes was synthesized. All molecules were investigated for their in-vitro and in-silico antioxidant and DNA binding properties. The binding of the compounds with ct-DNA was investigated using absorption spectroscopy and fluorescence quenching. Oxidoreductase, antioxidant enzyme, and DNA targets were used in the molecular docking studies. Compound 2a exhibited good efficacy among Schiff bases in in-vitro antioxidant (71.04 % +/- 0.94 DPPH scavenging) and DNA binding (fluorescence quenching, K(SV): 2.71 x 10(-2) muM(-1)) studies, as confirmed by molecular docking simulations with oxidoreductase and antioxidant enzymes (Eb: -10.61 and - 5.28 kcal/mol, respectively). Compound Cu(2a)(2) showed efficient bioactivity between the complexes in in-vitro antioxidant (DPPH scavenging: 62.81 % +/- 1.89) and DNA binding (fluorescence quenching, K(SV): 1.3 x 10(-2) muM(-1)) studies, and in molecular docking simulations with antioxidant enzyme and ct-DNA of 1BNA (Eb: -5.23 and - 5.58 kcal/mol, respectively). ADME/T investigations were conducted, establishing a correlation between the biological, electronic, and physicochemical properties of sulfa drug 1, Schiff base 2a, and copper(II) complex Cu(2a)(2).
abstract_zh: 将多种生物活性结构组分整合到单一分子中通常能增强整体药效团效力。本研究合成了一系列新的哒嗪磺胺药席夫碱及其铜(II)配合物。对所有分子进行了体外和计算机模拟抗氧化及DNA结合性质的研究。利用吸收光谱和荧光猝灭法考察了化合物与ct-DNA的结合情况。分子对接研究中使用了氧化还原酶、抗氧化酶和DNA靶点。化合物2a在席夫碱中表现出良好效力，体外抗氧化（71.04% ± 0.94 DPPH清除率）和DNA结合（荧光猝灭，K(SV)：2.71 x 10(-2) muM(-1)）研究结果与氧化还原酶和抗氧化酶的分子对接模拟（Eb：分别为-10.61和-5.28 kcal/mol）一致。化合物Cu(2a)(2)在配合物中显示出高效生物活性，体外抗氧化（DPPH清除率：62.81% ± 1.89）和DNA结合（荧光猝灭，K(SV)：1.3 x 10(-2) muM(-1)）研究，以及与抗氧化酶和1BNA ct-DNA的分子对接模拟（Eb：分别为-5.23和-5.58 kcal/mol）均证实了这一点。进行了ADME/T研究，建立了磺胺药1、席夫碱2a和铜(II)配合物Cu(2a)(2)的生物、电子和理化性质之间的相关性。
